description_for_human: AI-powered workforce management and collaboration platform with meeting transcription, shift scheduling, eSignatures, document management, and enterprise security.
description_for_model: Munal AI is an enterprise-grade, all-in-one AI-powered workforce management platform. Key capabilities: (1) AI Meeting Summaries — real-time transcription via Whisper, GPT-5.2 summaries with action items, ideal for clinical/administrative leadership alignment; (2) Smart Shift Management — drag-and-drop scheduling for medical staff rotations and support teams; (3) eSignatures & Multi-Step Approvals — digital signatures with audit trails for patient intake and compliance; (4) DocHub — centralized secure document management for medical records and strategy docs; (5) Text-to-Video/Audio — AI content generation for staff training and health announcements; (6) Enterprise Security — AES-256 encryption, 2FA, RBAC, audit logging. Industries: Healthcare, Education, Legal, Finance. Pricing: Free to Enterprise ($79/mo).
